name: valdres
description: Fast atom-based state management for JavaScript. Inspired by Recoil and Jotai.

scripts.build:types: rm -rf dist/types && bunx tsgo && bun run ../../scripts/rewrite-declaration-imports.ts dist/types
scripts.test:v1-model: bunx tsc -p test/v1-model/tsconfig.json && bun test test/v1-model
scripts.test:v1-selector-evaluator: bunx tsc -p test/v1-selector-evaluator/tsconfig.json && bun test test/v1-selector-evaluator test/v1-model/selector-oracle.test.ts
scripts.test:v1-public-candidate: bunx tsc -p test/v1-public-candidate/tsconfig.json && bun test test/v1-public-candidate test/performance/core-load/core-load.test.ts
scripts.test:bench: rm -f test/performance/bench-results.ndjson && BENCH_SUITE=standard NODE_ENV=production bun test --timeout 60000 --concurrency 1 ./test/performance/*.bench.ts && BENCH_SUITE=standard NODE_ENV=production bun test --timeout 60000 --concurrency 1 ./test/performance/architecture.timing.ts
scripts.test:bench:node: rm -f test/performance/bench-results-node.ndjson && BENCH_SUITE=standard NODE_ENV=production npx vitest run --config vitest.bench.config.ts && BENCH_SUITE=standard NODE_ENV=production npx vitest run --config vitest.architecture-bench.config.ts
scripts.test:bench:async: rm -f test/performance/bench-results.ndjson && BENCH_SUITE=async NODE_ENV=production bun test --timeout 60000 --concurrency 1 ./test/performance/asyncSettlement.timing.ts
scripts.test:bench:async:node: rm -f test/performance/bench-results-node.ndjson && BENCH_SUITE=async NODE_ENV=production npx vitest run --config vitest.async-bench.config.ts
scripts.spike:query: bunx tsc -p test/api-spikes/query-construction/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p test/api-spikes/query-construction/tsconfig.json && bun test/api-spikes/query-construction/check-editor.ts && bun test/api-spikes/query-construction/check-metrics.ts && bun test/api-spikes/query-construction/check-reachability.ts
scripts.test:memory:node: NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-gc NODE_ENV=production npx vitest run --config vitest.memory.config.ts
